build_PatchEmbed_default: build a PatchEmbed module with default 224x224 image size and 16x16 patch size for vision transformer input
create_PatchEmbed_custom: create a PatchEmbed module with custom image size, patch size, and embedding dimension for ViT architectures
run_PatchEmbed_forward: run the PatchEmbed forward pass to convert a batch of images into flattened patch embeddings
test_PatchEmbed_flops: test the PatchEmbed flops method to calculate floating point operations for the convolutional projection layer
review_make_2tuple: review the make_2tuple helper function that normalizes int or tuple inputs into a 2-tuple for image and patch dimensions
